premises.name: physical-pair logarithmic envelope
premises.scope: invertible indefinite original-coordinate physical pair; arbitrary dependent pair shifts induced by remaining original coordinates

premises.name: global off-diagonal weighted-Fourier theorem
premises.scope: every symmetric residual quadratic-plus-affine form with independent cap-one original coordinates and positive ordered off-diagonal energy; 0<beta<1/2

new_results.statement: For k_a(x)=log_+(a/|x|), if W_beta(R)=integral |t|^(beta-1)|phi_R(t)|dt<infinity, then sup_s E k_a(s-R) <= 2^(1-beta) pi^(-1) a^beta W_beta(R).

For an invertible indefinite original-coordinate pair P with D=|det B|, kappa=sigma_min(B), ordered overlap-two star W2(P)>0, every 0<beta<1/2 gives ||p_Q||inf <= M_beta D^((beta-1/2)/(2beta+1)) kappa^(-beta/(2beta+1)) W2^(-beta/[2(2beta+1)]). At beta=1/4 the constant is 20.81337504449044.
With R_*=kappa^(1/4) W2^(1/8)/D^(1/2), ||p_Q||inf <=100 sqrt(log(e+R_*)) kappa^(-1/4) W2^(-1/8). Essential boundedness only.

exact_structural_identity: For the exact Schur complement S of an invertible physical pair P, W2(P)=|det B|^2 sum_{k!=l} S_kl^2.

designated_partner_applied.application: For Delta=epsilon^(-1), a=epsilon, c=-epsilon, QFORM-RANK2-CROSS-COORD-SEPARABLE-KERNEL-L2-v1 gives ||p_Q||inf<=9/2 and a continuous C_0 density. The main report also equation-applies r39 to obtain the exact bound 16 on its pair-Schur stress family.

next_step: In the strict no-pivot class, route global exterior-three/amplified-core currency to an aggregate pair-star, exact singular pair, rank-two Schur/kernel receiver, or already-paid diffuse/grouped/ridge/hub branch before selecting any tiny physical 3x3 minor.
